text.title: Micro-MVPs Worked Example
text.summary: End-to-end worked example showing inputs → procedure → output for a typical instance of Micro-MVPs.

example.scenario: Solo founder ships 4-day Micro-MVP testing 'engineers will pay for this' on 20 newsletter subs; success ≥3 paid signups, kill <1; result 4 paid → continue.

example.title: Dropbox video demo
example.note: Assumption: people want easy file sync across devices.
Micro-MVP: a 3-minute video explaining the concept, posted online. No code written.
Result: waitlist jumped from 5,000 to 75,000 overnight. Validated demand without building a single byte of sync infrastructure.
Experiment type: video demo (hours) from the catalogue in 01-core-rules — matched to a demand assumption per r6-match-experiment-type.
